institutionName: UiT The Arctic University of Norway

questions.question: What motivated you to go on exchange? (pick the most important one) *
questions.answer: Explore new cultures

questions.question: Which aspects were crucial to choosing your study destination? *
questions.answer:
At kunne opleve og lære om det arktiske miljø. 
Vild og flot natur.

questions.question: How would you rate your overall study abroad experience? *
Additional comments:
questions.answer: Super fed oplevelse

questions.question: How easy was it to find the information you needed to know upon arrival? *
questions.answer: Det var okay. Blev lidt overvældet af den store mængde af mails, som blev sendt. Men jeg kunne finde al information, som der var behov for.

questions.question: What assistance, if any, did you receive when you arrived at your study destination? *
questions.answer: Vi blev taget godt imod af tutorer, som stod for et introprogram.

questions.question: Overall, how satisfied were you with the orientation and assistance available to students at your host institution upon arrival? *
Additional comments
questions.answer: Synes det var okay - men med plads til forbedringer

questions.question: How did you find housing? *
questions.answer: I found housing through my host institution

questions.question: Did you live on campus or off campus? *
questions.answer: On campus

questions.question: What options were available for on campus housing? *
questions.answer: Der var en masse forskellige kollegier. Jeg boede på panorama, på køkken sammen med 14 nordmænd. Det ligger lige mellem centrum og uni, så det var super nemt.

questions.question: What options were available for meal plans or cooking facilities? *
questions.answer: Der var et køkken.

questions.question: What should future exchange students know about living in on campus housing? *
questions.answer: Der var mange forskellige muligheder og det var en god måde at møde andre på - både udvekslingsstuderende og nordmænd

questions.question: Overall, how satisfied were you with the housing available to students? *
Additional comments:
How easy did you find the registration process at your host institution? *
Additional comments:
Please describe the registration process at your host institution *
questions.answer: Meldte mig til kurserne gennem universitetets hjemmeside.

questions.question: What kind of help was available? *
questions.answer: Det var nemt at skrive til lederne af fakulteterne, hvis jeg havde spørgsmål om kurserne.

questions.question: How successful were you in registering for the classes you wanted? *
questions.answer: Jeg endte med at få de kurser jeg gerne ville have.

questions.question: What advice would you offer to future exchange students about registration at your host institution? *
questions.answer: Vær ikke bleg for at sende mails og spørge rundt, meget kan lade sig gøre. Jeg fik først rigtigt styr på mine kurser en uge efter jeg ankom til Tromsø.

questions.answer: BA

questions.answer: BA

questions.answer: Jeg synes ikke niveauet var specielt højt

questions.answer: Var ret meget det samme

questions.answer: 1 semester

questions.question: Please list the courses you were enrolled in during your first semester. *
questions.answer:
GEO-2015: Introduction to snow and avalanche science
SPL-1002: Geography and Society
SPL-2012: Geographical Information Systems in community- and land-use planning

questions.question: What specific courses would you recommend to future exchange students? Why? *
questions.answer: GEO-2015 var et mega sejt kursus. Vi var på en uges felttur, hvor vi boede i en hytte. Hver dag tog vi ud i felten med ski på og lavede analyser af sneen.

questions.question: How satisfied were you with the non-academic opportunities (clubs, sports, etc.) at your host institution? *
Additional comments:
questions.answer: Der var vildt gode muligheder for at stå på ski. Jeg stod på langrend, alpin og en masse topptur.

questions.question: What kinds of cultural, athletic and social activities were available for students at your host institution? *
questions.answer: Der var TSI, som minder om KSI - de tilbød en masse forskellige fritidsaktiviteter.

questions.question: Which non -academic activities would you recommend to future exchange students? Why? *
questions.answer: Stå på ski og tage på ture - er mega fedt!

questions.question: What do you recommend other visiting students see or do on their weekends or holidays? *
questions.answer: Benytte DNT-hytter. Der ligger en masse hytter rundt omkring i Tromsø, som man kan billigt og nemt kan bruge. Desuden kan man leje gratis udstyr (snesko, fjellski, liggeunderlag og meget andet) hos Turbo, som ligger ved biblioteket nede i byen.

questions.question: How easy was it to adjust to the local culture of your exchange site? *
questions.answer: ret nemt - minder meget om dansk kultur

questions.question: Do you have any tips for socializing with local students?
questions.answer: På kollegierne og til undervisning - men hang nu mest ud med andre udvekslingsstuderene, hvilket også var super nice.

questions.question: What, if any, cultural differences did you find particularly challenging? *
questions.answer: ingen

questions.question: What parts of the culture did you most appreciate? *
questions.answer: Den nemme tilgang til naturen

questions.question: What are the three most important things you would tell a UCPH student who is going to your host institution on exchange? *
questions.answer:
Stå på ski
Tag på ture - både korte og lange 
Tag afsted - Tromsø er en KÆMPE oplevelse og NYD det!
